_doc: Playable canonical jobs and advancement rewards (GAME_DESIGN section 9). Missing jobs are locked; optional level overrides the canonical level. grants.max_hp adds base HP; grants.max_mp adds job MP. format1_weapon is the frozen tier C spec #32 migration weapon, resolved through lineage. Every weapon-grant job except the Magician uses paths: [{id, label, item_id, family}], id == family, in default page order. One advancement entry per child job carries its paths; tier-2 paths put the held family first. An empty choice defaults to the first page path. Only the chosen item is worn, without requirements; displaced equipment goes to the Equip tab and spills at the feet when full (tier C owner #226). Jobs with >=2 paths record weapon_path, including tier-2 choices; jobs with 0 or 1 path preserve it. No extra_items, grants.items, weapon_families or grant_items. Magician 200 keeps balance.player.weapon_grants. No skills granted: advancement opens an extra skill draw before the normal draw (tier C #31).
